text:
elaine: Customer hit duplicated SSE fragments after quick cellular->wifi handoff. sampleapp shows message parts replayed by proxy.

tom: can you paste the raw stream piece?

vik: excerpt:

```
event: message
data: {"id":"x9","seq":1,"part":"Hi \\"}

--conn reset--

event: message
data: {"id":"x9","seq":2,"part":"there"}

event: message
data: {"id":"x9","seq":2,"part":"there"}
```

vik: proxy replayed the second part; client applied both -> "Hithereere" in some runs.

elaine: which SDKs affected?

vik: Node and Android sampleapps; Go SDK already dedupes by (id,seq).

tom: plan: (1) client-side dedupe on (id,seq), (2) buffer incomplete JSON across SSE boundaries and only parse when complete, (3) add ttl to clear partials. I'll own Node PR.

ci-bot: CI queued for branch fix/sse-replay-guard (job #5043).

elaine: add a minimal opt-in repro to sampleapp (simulate-handoff --replay) and update troubleshooting docs. I'll follow up with customer once QA verifies.
